name: Printable Studio — Elegant Classic House Style
intent: An elegant, classic, editorial family of print-first products; visually related but never visually identical.

layout.cover_rule: Designed cover distinct from functional interior; avoid repeated interior layouts.
layout.body_rule: One primary accent, ample whitespace, no full-bleed backgrounds on write-in sheets.
layout.repeat_page_rule: Duplicate useful blank templates without suffixes such as 'Extra 1'; do not pad with unnecessary repetitions.

classic_botanical.label: Classic Botanical
classic_botanical.cover: Spacious serif title, fine line-drawn botanical motifs, delicate frame or stem drawing.
classic_botanical.interior: Mostly white with sage mini-headings and light writing rules; herb sketch only on cover or section intro.

heritage_editorial.label: Heritage Editorial
heritage_editorial.cover: Editorial serif, precise alignment, thin frame, minimal ornament.
heritage_editorial.interior: Typographic hierarchy and symmetrical sections; handwritten space is prioritized.

soft_reflection.label: Soft Reflection
soft_reflection.cover: Calm layout with ample breathing room; no visual urgency.
soft_reflection.interior: Low-stimulation prompts, readable text, generous spacing, restrained visual details.
soft_reflection.content_guardrail: General reflection and organization only; no promises of diagnosis, cure, or treatment.

refined_utility.label: Refined Utility
refined_utility.cover: Confident typography and architectural spacing, limited accent color.
refined_utility.interior: Scannable tables, clear sections, well-sized fields, unambiguous labels.

review_checks: All explicitly requested worksheets are present
trend_policy: Refresh optional accent directions seasonally; maintain legibility, product fit, and the brand's classic core.
